common.loadError: The data could not be loaded. Please try again.

forbidden.title: No permission
forbidden.message: Your role does not give access to this section.

welcome.step1: We will email you a 6-digit code.
welcome.step2: You choose your option and review it before confirming.
welcome.step3: You get a receipt code to check that your vote is in the ballot box.
welcome.secret: Your vote is secret: nobody can know what you voted. You can vote only once.

code.title: Access code
code.intro: To check that it is you, we will email you an access code.
code.sentTo: We have sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
code.label: Access code
code.resendIn: You can ask for another code in {{time}}
code.wrong: The code is not correct. You have {{remaining}} attempts left.
code.expired: The code has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
code.tooSoon: Please wait a little before asking for another code.
code.mailFailed: We could not send the email. Please try again in a few minutes.

ballot.help: Choose one option. You can review it before voting.
ballot.blankHelp: It counts as participation but supports no option.
ballot.missing: You have not chosen an option yet.

review.title: Review your vote
review.notYet: You have not voted yet. Once you confirm, your vote cannot be changed.

receipt.title: Vote recorded
receipt.message: Thank you. Your vote is in the ballot box.
receipt.keep: Keep this code: it is shown only now. It lets you check that your vote is in the ballot box; it does not show what you voted.

notOpen.title: Voting is not open yet
notOpen.message: You can vote from {{opens}}. Open this link again then.

closed.title: Voting is closed
closed.message: The period ended on {{closes}}. Votes can no longer be cast.

invalidLink.title: This link is not valid
invalidLink.message: Use the link in your latest invitation email. If you are not on the voter list, contact your organization.

expiredLink.title: The link has expired
expiredLink.message: Contact your organization to receive a new link.

locked.title: Access temporarily blocked
locked.message: Too many attempts. For your security, wait until {{until}} and try again.

alreadyVoted.title: You have already voted
alreadyVoted.messageOn: Your vote was recorded on {{day}}. You can vote only once.
alreadyVoted.message: Your vote is already recorded. You can vote only once.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.message: Your choice was not saved and you have not voted. Open the same link again.

notRecorded.title: Your vote was NOT recorded
notRecorded.message: The connection or the server failed. You can retry safely: two votes will never be recorded.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: We could not load the vote. Please try again in a few minutes.

verify.title: Check my receipt
verify.intro: Type or paste your receipt code to check that your vote is in the ballot box.
verify.label: Receipt code
verify.format: The code must have 64 characters from 0-9 and a-f.
verify.present: Your vote is in the ballot box.
verify.absent: We cannot find that code in this vote. Check that it is complete.
verify.error: We could not check it. Please try again.
verify.limits: The receipt proves that your vote is in the ballot box; it does not show or prove what you voted.

footer.secure: Secure connection · Your vote is secret

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: This address does not exist. Check the link or go back to the start.
